command:
$app = "C:\Users\Abdullah G\Desktop\Website\flip-scanner-app"
$android = Join-Path $app "android"
"=== fix git identity ==="
git -C $app config user.name "pc-runner"
git -C $app config user.email "pc-runner@local"
git -C $app commit -m "Add Gradle wrapper (manual)" 2>&1 | Select-Object -Last 1
git -C $app pull --rebase 2>&1 | Select-Object -Last 1
git -C $app push 2>&1 | Select-Object -Last 1
"=== build ==="
$env:JAVA_HOME = "C:\Users\Abdullah G\Desktop\Website\flip-scanner\tools\jdk-21"
$env:ANDROID_HOME = "C:\Users\Abdullah G\Desktop\Website\flip-scanner\Android\Sdk"
$env:ANDROID_SDK_ROOT = $env:ANDROID_HOME
$gw = Join-Path $android "gradlew.bat"
& cmd /c "`"$gw`" -p `"$android`" assembleDebug" 2>&1 | Select-Object -Last 30
